outline:
各式數位科技已被廣泛應用在各產業，本課程主要是介紹數位轉型、智慧製造與永續生產相關之課題及其相關技術。
Many digital technologies have been widely used in various industries. This course mainly introduces topics related to digital transformation, smart manufacturing and sustainable production, as well as related technologies.
schedule:
week 1-week 3數位優化與轉型
week 4-week 6智慧製造與數位科技(AI)應用
week 7-week 9 MES, IOT與資訊安全技術
week 10-week 11 期中分組報告
week 12-week 14永續發展及淨零碳排議題
week 15-week 16商業模式
week 17-week 18 期末分組報告
scorePolicy:
上課出席 30%
心得報告 50%
上台簡報 20%
materials: 使用自編教材，上課前提供。
resources:
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
sdgs:
SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）
SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）
SDG12：負責任的消費與生產（Responsible Consumption and Production）
SDG13：氣候行動（Climate Action）
aiUsage:
● 使用生成式AI作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）
● 鼓勵學生使用生成式AI工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
● 簡單介紹AI的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
